scenes.title: First Tremble Beneath the Frosting
scenes.storyBeat: A frightened block voice hides beneath the sticky sprinkle flow.
storyboardPanels: Milo steps into a candy sewer alcove lit by soft sprinkle lanterns.
Sticky blocks pulse inside hardened frosting.
One sprinkle block trembles out of rhythm.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Hold on. That was not a drip.
Sticky blockage detected. Emotional classification: uncertain wobble.
No. Frightened. It is asking for one quiet corner.

choices.label: Sweep a Sprinkle Corner
choices.playerLine: First, a corner. Every frightened sound needs somewhere to sit.
choices.narration: Milo opens a safe pocket on the board. The trembling rune settles, though the deeper message fades.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain shield and a safer opening.

choices.label: Hear the First Tremble
choices.playerLine: I will not pull you free until I know what hurt you.
choices.narration: The rune answers in two tiny sounds: plink, hush. Milo hears that the blocks are afraid of being placed without being heard.
choices.gameplayResult: Warning insight grants mana and improves boss callback.

choices.label: Follow the Sugarbeat
choices.playerLine: Plink on the left, plonk on the right. I will follow before the frosting changes its mind.
choices.narration: Milo follows the sewer sugarbeat into a daring chain. The room sparkles, and the frosting pipes wake up too.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain extra mana with a chance of sticky risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: The board is crowded, not cruel.

victoryCallback.text: It sounds lighter now. Not fixed, maybe, but less alone.

bossCallback.text: Only if the little runes can still breathe.

scenes.title: The Counterbeat in the Gears
scenes.storyBeat: Machines produce pieces that argue in different rhythms.
storyboardPanels: Junk blocks carry tiny gear marks.

preChoiceDialogue.text: That machine is copying a sound it does not understand.
Tick where it should plink. Plonk where it should rest.

choices.label: Sort the Noisy Gears
choices.playerLine: I will steady the loudest gear first. The small sounds can wait one turn.
choices.narration: Milo adjusts the nearest conveyor rhythm and clears the worst junk pressure.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain a toolbox item for workshop cleanup.

choices.label: Name the Counterbeat
choices.playerLine: It is not noise. It is a second song trying to stand inside the first.

npcResponse.text: Sub-pattern identified: counterbeat. Emotional classification updated.

choices.narration: Milo gives the rhythm a name, and every conveyor moves in the right direction for one quiet moment.
choices.gameplayResult: Preview warnings improve for the boss.

choices.label: Ride the Conveyor Song
choices.playerLine: If the belts insist on singing, we may as well step in time.

npcResponse.text: Workshop waltz detected. Keep hats inside the marked area.

choices.narration: Milo times the board to the conveyor song. The machines become thrilled and over-helpful.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain gold with a chance of machine risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: Plink, tick, plonk. The machine can breathe too.

victoryCallback.text: The gears still argue, but now they are taking turns.

bossCallback.text: I AM OPERATING AT MAXIMUM HELPFULNESS.
You are operating at maximum panic. We will find the difference slowly.

scenes.title: The Long Pause of Ice
scenes.storyBeat: Frozen runes speak slowly and teach Milo not to interrupt.
storyboardPanels: A slow chime travels from block to block.
The active piece rims with frost but waits.

preChoiceDialogue.text: This place is not silent. It is speaking very, very slowly.
Thermal delay detected. Message delivery speed reduced.
If I hurry, I will only hear the first half of every word.

choices.label: Clear a Warm Pocket
choices.playerLine: I will warm one small place. The rest can thaw after the board is safe.
choices.narration: Milo clears a warm pocket. The immediate freeze danger softens.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain Hot Cocoa for freeze counterplay.

choices.label: Wait for the Ice to Answer
choices.playerLine: I hear you. I will not answer until your last chime arrives.
choices.narration: The frozen rune completes its message: not every delay is danger.
choices.gameplayResult: Freeze warnings gain a small route guard.

choices.label: Drop on the Second Chime
choices.playerLine: Not the first chime. The second. That is where the blue rune breathes.

npcResponse.text: Pantry bell timing considered brave and chilly.

choices.narration: Milo drops into a narrow opening on the second chime. The cascade is beautiful, and the pantry answers with playful frost.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain mana with a chance of speed-wave risk.

victoryCallback.text: The pantry answered. It only needed time.

bossCallback.text: Cold can also keep a sentence safe until it is ready.

scenes.title: The Nap-Song Under the Blankets
scenes.storyBeat: Even rooms need rest, not only repair.
storyboardPanels: Pillow walls breathe in sleepy rhythm.
Soft blocks settle like tucked blankets.
A quiet room asks not to be fixed too loudly.

preChoiceDialogue.text: This room is not broken. It is tired.
Then we should repair it softly enough that it can keep resting.

choices.label: Tuck the Board In
choices.playerLine: Soft edges first. A tucked board wobbles less.
choices.narration: Milo steadies the soft blocks and keeps the room from waking in a panic.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain shield for the next sleepy room.

choices.label: Learn the Nap-Song
choices.playerLine: I will listen to the room before I ask it to move.

npcResponse.text: Rest pattern recorded. Repair volume reduced.

choices.narration: Milo learns the small song the room hums to stay kind while asleep.
choices.gameplayResult: Sleepy pressure gives earlier warning through route insight.

choices.label: Tiptoe Through the Cascade
choices.playerLine: One small cascade. On toe blocks.

npcResponse.text: Tiptoe cascade registered. Applause will be whispered.

choices.narration: Milo sets a daring chain through soft blocks without fully waking the hall.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain Fever, with a chance of sleepy pressure.

victoryCallback.text: The room is still asleep. That means we helped.

bossCallback.text: Someone who learned the nap-song before knocking.

scenes.title: The Quiet Between Chimes
scenes.storyBeat: Arcade chimes drown out a small true rhythm.
storyboardPanels: Score lights flash over the board.
A tiny rhythm hides between loud chimes.
Milo covers one ear and listens smaller.

preChoiceDialogue.text: The arcade is very bright, but the small rhythm is still there.

choices.label: Dim the Score Lights
choices.playerLine: Less glare first. Then the board can speak clearly.
choices.narration: The score signs dim just enough for Milo to track the real rhythm.

choices.label: Hear Between Chimes
choices.playerLine: The quiet part is not empty. It is where the next piece asks to land.

npcResponse.text: Low-volume rhythm accepted. Scoreboard humility pending.

choices.narration: Milo hears the true rhythm under the arcade noise and keeps it safe.

choices.label: Play the Shimmer Pattern
choices.narration: Milo plays a shimmering pattern through the arcade chimes. It pays out loudly.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain gold and Fever with a risk of preview pressure.

postChoiceBarks.text: That was still very bright. But I heard them.

victoryCallback.text: The arcade has a quiet place now.

bossCallback.text: SMALLER IS NOT ON THE SCOREBOARD.
Then the scoreboard is missing something.

scenes.locationName: Bloxley's Block Palace - Royal Symmetry Hall
scenes.title: The Palace That Forgot How to Ask
scenes.storyBeat: The palace asks whether order is a crown or a shelter.
storyboardPanels: Royal blocks line up in perfect silence.
Bloop makes no echo in the hall.
Milo notices no tiny plink can escape.

preChoiceDialogue.text: It is too quiet. Not resting quiet. Not listening quiet.
Royal arrangement detected. Variance: zero. Comfort: unconfirmed.
The blocks are not arguing anymore. That is what worries me.

choices.label: Loosen the Royal Corners
choices.playerLine: Even a palace needs room at the edges.
choices.narration: Milo softens the palace pattern enough to move forward safely.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain shield before the final palace pressure.

choices.label: Ask the Palace Why
choices.playerLine: Who told you that perfect rows were safer than being heard?

npcResponse.text: Unexpected query received. Palace silence contains archived loneliness.

choices.narration: Milo asks why the palace became so still and hears loneliness under the perfect rows.
choices.gameplayResult: Royal pattern warnings become easier to read.

choices.label: Dance the Crooked Square
choices.playerLine: A square can still dance if one corner is brave.

npcResponse.text: Unauthorized palace dancing allowed on artistic grounds.

choices.narration: Milo introduces a crooked rhythm into the perfect hall. The palace brightens; the guards object.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain strong mana with possible royal pattern risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: A perfect row can still be lonely.

victoryCallback.text: He built all of this so no one would have to ask where he belonged.

bossCallback.text: That may be why they keep wobbling.
